finding_recheck.trace: Observer::new uses IntoObserverSystem with default Out=() and rejects exclusive systems (native 9:218–243; 13:9–16,32–50). Function systems require IntoResult<Out> (12:576–612); the selected explicit fallible forms for output () are Result<(),RunSystemError> and Result<(),BevyError>. Historical P16 iteration.rs 154–160 installs callbacks; historical logging.rs 198–206 and 302–310 declare MeleeGeometryResult<()> and fabelgeist_geometry::GeometryResult<()> respectively. GeometryResult is an alias for Result<T,GeometryError> (historical geometry error.rs 3–4), not the selected Bevy error forms. Prior owner identified this native callback port as unfinished; no compilation was attempted and no current compile error is asserted.
finding_recheck.native_failure_port: If an accepted observer system returns Failed, native runner 11:110–123 invokes its configured handler or fallback, then queues deferred work if the handler returns. World fallback uses an installed FallbackErrorHandler or default (14:3458–3465); native handler 105–120 and 127–145 defaults to severity dispatch, and native BevyError 400–410 converts supported errors into boxed causes with default Panic severity. Actual handler configuration, skip/failure policy and final report readback are application concerns, not inferred from lock alone. Skipped parameter validation is explicitly a separate non-error native variant (system.rs 389–396), so it is not automatically an unhandled failure.
finding_recheck.current_95e: In independently displayed current logging.rs 197–205 and 299–307, both selected callbacks return unit. Same install positions are visible in current iteration.rs 154–160. This narrows the current claim: the historical typed callback incompatibility is not demonstrated by those selected current signatures; it does not prove all callbacks/paths safe or that the old finding is repaired.
